fields.description: Issue includes commentary on Florida Power & Light and state taxation/municipal ownership; an exposé alleging deceptive sales practices at Browning King Co., Inc. on East Flagler Street; a report linking Miami’s “Torture Doctor” T. Earl Moore to the death of painter D. Kuhl and discussion of other alleged patient harms; political commentary on Republicans and public relations; coverage of proposed/expanded summer dog racing and legal obstacles to repeal in Dade County; a nuisance lawsuit over odors/noise from a poultry/slaughter/quick-freeze plant in Opa-locka; notes on segregation and job discrimination in Washington, D.C.; and local civic/business items including Miami International Airport statistics and state government briefs.
